M62=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in rawm.strip().split("\n")])
idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AA)}; enc=lambda s: np.array([idx.get(c,22) for c in s])
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    e1,e2=enc(s1),enc(s2);n,m=len(s1),len(s2);S=M62[np.ix_(e1,e2)];NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);X=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Y=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    PM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);PX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);PY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): X[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1)
    for j in range(1,m+1): Y[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            c=(M[i-1,j-1],X[i-1,j-1],Y[i-1,j-1]);k=int(np.argmax(c));M[i,j]=c[k]+S[i-1,j-1];PM[i,j]=k
            c=(M[i-1,j]+go,X[i-1,j]+ge,Y[i-1,j]+go);k=int(np.argmax(c));X[i,j]=c[k];PX[i,j]=k
            c=(M[i,j-1]+go,X[i,j-1]+go,Y[i,j-1]+ge);k=int(np.argmax(c));Y[i,j]=c[k];PY[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m;st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],X[n,m],Y[n,m]]));P=[PM,PX,PY];pairs=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: pairs.append((i,j));ns=P[0][i,j];i-=1;j-=1;st=ns
        elif st==1: ns=P[1][i,j];i-=1;st=ns
        else: ns=P[2][i,j];j-=1;st=ns
        if i==0 and j==0: break
    return pairs[::-1]
hs="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q8TDR0.fasta",timeout=120).text.split("\n")[1:])
ce="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q17595.fasta",timeout=120).text.split("\n")[1:])
h2c=dict(nw(hs,ce))
VAR=[(17,"I","S","SLSN9, altered N-terminal folding"),(125,"V","A","SLSN9, altered N-terminal folding"),
     (125,"V","M","SLSN9, altered folding; fails to localise to ciliary tip"),(520,"M","R","SLSN9, fails to localise to ciliary tip")]
print("Human IFT54 SLSN9 variants mapped onto DYF-11 (global alignment, 30.5% identity):")
for p,wt,mt,note in VAR:
    if p in h2c:
        q=h2c[p]; print(f"  Hs {wt}{p}{mt}  ->  DYF-11 {ce[q-1]}{q}   identical={ce[q-1]==wt}   [{note}]")
    else:
        print(f"  Hs {wt}{p}{mt}  ->  aligned to a gap in DYF-11   [{note}]")

# AlphaFold pLDDT for DYF-11 with CH domain, variant positions and train-contact window
pdb=requests.get(requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q17595",timeout=120).json()[0]["pdbUrl"],timeout=300).text
pl={}
for l in pdb.split("\n"):
    if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA": pl[int(l[22:26])]=float(l[60:66])
res=np.array(sorted(pl)); b=np.array([pl[r] for r in res])
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12,4))
ax.plot(res,b,lw=1.2,color="#2b6cb0")
ax.axhspan(90,100,color="#2f855a",alpha=.07); ax.axhspan(70,90,color="#d69e2e",alpha=.07)
ax.axvspan(3,111,color="#2f855a",alpha=.12,label="NN-CH domain 3-111 (mean pLDDT 89.8)")
ax.axvspan(405,510,color="#3182ce",alpha=.12,label="region equivalent to the IFT54 train-contact window")
for p,wt,mt,note in VAR:
    q=h2c.get(p)
    if q:
        ax.axvline(q,color="#c53030",ls="--",lw=1)
        ax.text(q,103,f"{wt}{p}{mt}\n->{ce[q-1]}{q}",ha="center",fontsize=7,color="#c53030")
ax.set_xlabel("DYF-11 residue"); ax.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT")
ax.set_title("DYF-11 (Q17595) AlphaFold confidence, with human SLSN9 IFT54 variant positions mapped by alignment",fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylim(0,112); ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower center")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("\nmean pLDDT 3-111:",round(np.mean([pl[r] for r in range(3,112)]),1))
print("mean pLDDT 405-510:",round(np.mean([pl[r] for r in range(405,511) if r in pl]),1))
